fake-runner-token-value

Install machine runner 3 on Debian or Ubuntu

1. Add the CircleCI package repository
   $ curl -s https://packagecloud.io/install/repositories/circleci/runner/script.deb.sh?any=true | sudo bash

2. Install the runner
   $ sudo apt-get install -y circleci-runner

3. Put the token in the runner config
   $ export RUNNER_AUTH_TOKEN="<the token printed above>"
   $ sudo sed -i "s/<< AUTH_TOKEN >>/$RUNNER_AUTH_TOKEN/g" /etc/circleci-runner/circleci-runner-config.yaml
   On CircleCI server, point the agent at your server: set the url field under api: in the config, or CIRCLECI_RUNNER_API_URL in the environment.

4. Start the runner and check it is running
   $ sudo systemctl enable circleci-runner && sudo systemctl start circleci-runner
   $ sudo systemctl status circleci-runner
   Logs: journalctl -u circleci-runner -f

Then run a job on it, in .circleci/config.yml:

version: 2.1

jobs:
  runner:
    machine: true
    resource_class: my-org/new-runner
    steps:
      - run: echo "Hi I'm on Runners!"

workflows:
  build-workflow:
    jobs:
      - runner

Docs: https://circleci.com/docs/runner/install-machine-runner-3-on-linux/
